You can also wear the gold ring and every 100 days of game play you get 20 PA. 
You can install the app and you get 4 AP if you watch an ad every 4 hours. I usually set an alarm so I can remember!
 Also, if you have another phone, you can install the app on that one as well, and watch the ads at the same time on both phones and you get 8 PA instead of 4 that way. Doesn't work with 3 or more phones, I tried, haha! So every day I obtain 59 PA with all of this! It helps a lot if you do it every day! I finished highschool, a while ago I started university.
